SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.receipt_id, f.line_no, f.sale_date, f.sale_ts_utc, f.channel_code, f.quantity, f.net_amount, f.staff_purchase_flag, f.etl_loaded_at, s.store_id, p.sku, p.category
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
WHERE s.store_id=131 AND p.sku=101624 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-26' AND DATE '2026-10-06'
ORDER BY f.sale_ts_utc

SELECT 'closure' k, CAST(closure_start_date AS VARCHAR) a, CAST(closure_end_date AS VARCHAR) b, closure_type c, NULL d FROM ref_store_closure WHERE store_id=131
UNION ALL
SELECT 'return', CAST(r.return_date AS VARCHAR), CAST(r.sales_line_id AS VARCHAR), CAST(r.quantity_returned AS VARCHAR), r.reason_code FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key WHERE s.store_id=131 AND p.sku=101624 AND r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-28' AND DATE '2026-10-04'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'rpt', CAST(business_date AS VARCHAR), CAST(receipts AS VARCHAR), CAST(units_sold AS VARCHAR), CAST(net_sales AS VARCHAR) FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE store_id=131 AND business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-28' AND DATE '2026-10-04'

SELECT sum(f.quantity) units, count(*) n, count(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) nd, (SELECT sum(units_sold) FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE store_id=131 AND business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-28' AND DATE '2026-10-04') rpt_units
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
WHERE s.store_id=131 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-28' AND DATE '2026-10-04'

SELECT s.store_id, s.store_name, p.sku, p.product_name, SUM(f.quantity) AS units_sold
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
WHERE s.store_id = 131 AND p.sku = 101624 AND s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
  AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-28' AND DATE '2026-10-04'
GROUP BY ALL
